jobs.title: Chief of Staff (CEO's Office)
jobs.location: Palo Alto, California, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com .

About the Team

The Office of the CEO operates at the center of Turing's highest-priority strategic initiatives. We partner across executive leadership while representing the company externally with investors, frontier AI labs, enterprise customers, board members, strategic partners, and industry leaders.

This team exists to create leverage for the CEO where the company's most important external decisions are made.

The Role

This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role. Rather than running internal operations, you will become the CEO's external force multiplier. You’ll be in the room, at the table, on the plane, and in the follow-up thread for the most important external conversations the company has—with investors, frontier AI labs, Fortune 500 executives, strategic partners, journalists, and board members—and ensure those high-stakes conversations translate into impactful outcomes.

Often, successful candidates view this opportunity as an intense tour of duty. You will see and influence more consequential decisions in this role than most people experience in a decade.

For the right person, this tour can become a pathway to executive leadership at Turing—or a launchpad toward becoming a founder yourself.

Why This Role Matters

Over the next 12 months, Turing will navigate one of the most consequential periods in its growth. Success in this role will directly influence how effectively the CEO scales relationships with investors, frontier AI labs, strategic partners, and enterprise leaders while advancing the company's long-term growth strategy.

You will be a trusted strategic partner to the CEO on the company's highest-priority external initiatives. You will help execute Turing's next capital formation milestone, build repeatable systems for managing the CEO's most important external relationships, elevate the quality of executive materials and strategic communications, and independently drive company-defining initiatives on behalf of the CEO.

What You Will Own

- Lead Turing's Capital Agenda. Own the defining project of the next 12 months. You run the CEO-side process with the CEO and our advisors: investor target lists, sequencing, materials, data room coordination, diligence management, and relentless follow-through. You have seen a process like this from the investor side. Now you will help run one from the inside.

- Turing’s External Narrative. Deliver the decks and memos for the meetings that matter most: investors, lab leadership, board, press, and strategic partners. You write at the level of the best investment memos you have read, and you build decks a CEO can walk into a room with—unedited.

- Drive Strategic Partnerships. Prepare, sequence, and drive follow-through on our largest commercial relationships with frontier labs—relationships that can reach nine and ten figures. Own pre-reads, stakeholder maps, term summaries, relationship context, and next steps that actually happen.

- Build Executive Relationship Intelligence. Build and operate the systems that ensure the CEO's highest-value relationships remain informed, intentional, and active. These relationships span researchers, human data and operations leaders, executives across frontier AI labs and enterprise customers, and the investor community. You build and run the system that keeps every one of them warm: briefing docs before every meeting, intelligence on what each person cares about, and follow-ups that land within 24 hours.

- Execute High-Impact Special Projects. Lead confidential strategic initiatives requiring judgment, discretion, and exceptional execution. Bring recommendations, not questions, and consistently deliver complete staff work.

What You Will Not Own

This role intentionally focuses on external strategy and execution. You will not:

- Own internal company operating cadence

- Manage executive calendars, travel, or administrative support

- Lead finance strategy or financial modeling

- Own GTM account execution

- Manage internal program management functions

Who You Are

- An investor and a dealmaker. You have 2-4 years in investment banking, growth equity, venture, or corporate development, and you have carried a live process to close. A background that combines finance or top-tier consulting with venture is ideal. What we are screening for is someone who has run something with a deadline, a counterparty, and consequences.

- A network multiplier. You build meaningful relationships across the venture and growth ecosystem—with partners, principals, founders, and rising operators—and your network expands ours.

- An elite storyteller.  You write at the level of the best investment memos you have read. Your writing sample will matter more than your resume. You can distill a complex business into a narrative that investors remember, partners repeat, and executives can confidently take into the room.

- Organized to the point of obsession. Nothing you own gets dropped. Ever. You keep the CEO organized as a byproduct of keeping yourself organized.

- A magnetic connector. Dinners, conferences, board meetings, customer visits, demo days, and travel energize you. You are comfortable with the most senior people in the room and the EQ to put anyone at ease. With warm grounded confidence, you turn conversations into relationships. People seek you out, remember you, and take your call.

- AI-Fluent by design. You are fluent enough in the AI market to hold your own with lab leadership. RL environments, evals, benchmarks, what the labs are actually buying and why. You will be tested on this.

- Discreet by default. You will know things almost no one else knows. That information never moves.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree from a top-tier university with a strong record of academic excellence.

- 2+ years at a top-tier Silicon Valley venture firm—Associate or Senior Associate.

- Exceptional written communication skills with experience producing investment memos, board materials, executive communications, or strategic presentations.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to build trust across senior stakeholders.

- Ability and willingness to travel frequently for domestic and international to AI hubs and conferences.

Preferred Qualifications

- Background that combines venture capital with prior experience in management consulting or investment banking.

- 2–5 years at a top-tier Silicon Valley venture firm—Associate or Senior Associate.

- Existing relationships within the Silicon Valley venture, growth equity, or frontier AI ecosystem.

- Experience supporting fundraising, capital formation, M&A, or strategic partnerships.

- Experience working directly with CEOs or executive leadership teams.

- Familiarity with enterprise software, AI infrastructure, or frontier AI markets.

- Experience preparing executives for board meetings, investor meetings, or strategic negotiations.

Before You Apply

- This role operates at the pace of the CEO. Capital markets, frontier AI labs, and strategic partners do not work standard business hours. Investor conversations may happen over a weekend. Critical negotiations may require immediate follow-up across multiple time zones.

- Extraordinary outcomes require extraordinary commitment, and we are transparent about those expectations. This is not a traditional Monday-through-Friday role, nor is it intended to become one.

- If you are optimizing for standard working hours or work-life balance at this stage of your career, this is not the right role—and we'd rather you know that now.

- For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help shape one of the defining AI companies of this generation while gaining the judgment and operating experience that often precede executive leadership, venture partnership, or company founding. Along the way, you will build lasting relationships with leading researchers, executives, founders, and investors across the frontier AI ecosystem.

Location & Work Model

- Full-time, in-office role with time in both our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices and the flexibility to support the CEO wherever business requires (transportation will be provided transportation between offices).

- Up to 75% domestic and international travel

- Flexibility to support global stakeholders across multiple time zones

Compensation & Benefits

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000-$250,000 USD . In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable compensation, equity and additional benefits.

Individual compensation will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant business considerations.

Application Process

Please submit:

- Resume

- One writing sample you're proud of, such as an investment memo, board memo, strategic analysis, presentation, or similar work

Our interview process typically includes:

- Introductory conversation

- Executive interviews

- Working session

- Reference checks

- Offer

Equal Opportunity

Turing is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process for qualified individuals with disabilities.
Values

- We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

- We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

- We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

- Work at the frontier of AI , helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

- Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

- Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise , applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.

- Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

- Move at the pace of AI innovation , with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace  and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review  Turing's GDPR notice here .

About the role

Partner Manager, AI Ecosystem Partnerships · Turing Intelligence · United States (New York City preferred) · Full-time

Turing Intelligence builds and deploys AI systems for enterprises such as BlackRock, Apollo, PepsiCo, and Goldman Sachs. We run as a startup inside Turing, and our forward-deployed engineers work directly in client environments.

The foundation-model providers sell models and enterprise agreements, but they do not want to staff the implementation. Their customers still need someone to build real systems on those models, and that is our business. When a model provider recommends implementation partners into one of its enterprise accounts, we want Turing to be on that list.

We already have working relationships with two of the leading foundation-model providers. Both partners know us, but almost no revenue flows through either channel yet. We are hiring our first Partner Manager to change that: to sell Turing through and with these partners, run the partner programs behind that motion, and own the revenue that comes through the channel.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You will work on your own at first, and if the channel proves itself, you may build a team under it.

What you'll do

Sell through and with our partners

- Pitch Turing to the partners' account executives and field teams, so they recommend us into their enterprise accounts

- Build partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by mapping partner account teams onto our target accounts and joining their account planning

- Co-sell in the field: joint account plans, shared pursuit calls, and joint proposals

- Route Turing-originated enterprise demand toward partner consumption, which earns referrals back to us

- Own the revenue that comes through the channel, and grow it quarter over quarter

Run the partner programs

- Manage each program end to end: onboarding, registrations and referrals, certifications, tier progression, partner credits, market development funds, and training

- Keep the paperwork and tracking tight and consistent, and own partner pipeline reporting as the single source of truth inside Turing

- Run the partner cadence: regular partner check-ins, quarterly business reviews, executive meetings, and partner events

- Keep our engineers certified and current on each partner's platform, and turn each model or platform launch into activity across our accounts

Treat competing partners fairly

- Manage partners who compete with each other, keeping each partner's information separate and giving none of them an advantage over another

- Raise conflicts early and honestly, including where a partner's own services team competes with us or where our delivery capacity cannot back a commitment we are asked to make

Work across Turing

- Run the channel much as a general manager runs a vertical, working mostly with our financial services (BFSI) business and with other verticals as accounts require

- Build the case studies and references partners ask for before they recommend us, starting from delivered work and new wins

- Partner with our delivery leaders to make sure every commitment made through the channel can be staffed and delivered

What we're looking for

Required

- 5+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel, including at least 2 years carrying a quota or a partner-sourced revenue target

- Partner or alliance experience on the services side: you have managed a professional services or consulting firm's partnerships with cloud or technology vendors, ideally at a boutique or mid-size firm

- Both halves of the job: you have pitched your firm to a vendor's account teams and won referrals, and you have run a partner program's registrations, co-sell, tiers, and funding

- Fluency in the partner playbook: sourced versus influenced attribution, deal registration, co-sell, cloud marketplaces, and market development funds

- Discretion: you can manage partners who compete with each other and keep each relationship fair and separate

- Commercial judgment: you can read a P&L, model a referral structure against a margin floor, and tell revenue from profitable revenue

- Range: comfortable with a partner's field rep and a partner's executive, and with a delivery lead and a general manager inside Turing

- A player-coach who wants to do the work directly and build a channel from early stage

Preferred

- AI experience: partnerships with a foundation-model provider or AI platform, or selling AI implementation work

- Enough technical fluency to discuss model selection, agents, and deployment with an enterprise CTO or a partner's solutions architect

- Experience managing two or more competing vendor partnerships at the same time

- Experience selling into enterprise financial services

How you'll be measured

The first measure is revenue, and revenue growth, through the partner channel. Behind it sit partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue and joint customer wins, gross margin on partner-sourced work, partner tier progression, and the number of certified engineers on each partner platform.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role is $240,000–$260,000.
Values

- We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

- We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

- We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

- Work at the frontier of AI , helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

- Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

- Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise , applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.

- Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

- Move at the pace of AI innovation , with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.
